author: feral-core
description: Create and manage RECURRING routines (scheduled, repeating jobs) that run on a cron-like schedule. Use this for anything the user wants done repeatedly on a timer, e.g. 'do X every day at 5pm', 'every 30 minutes', 'every weekday at 9am'. A routine can either run a specific skill endpoint, run a free-text instruction through the brain, or kick off a workflow. This is distinct from feral_reminders, which is a one-shot reminder at a single time.

endpoints.description: Create a recurring routine. Provide a schedule via cron_expr. cron_expr accepts canonical scheduler forms ('daily 17:00', 'every 30m', 'every 2h', '0 9 * * *') OR natural language ('every day at 5pm', 'every morning', 'every weekday at 9am') which is normalized automatically. To run a skill on schedule pass skill_id + endpoint_id (+ optional args). To run a free-text instruction through the brain each time, pass prompt. To launch a workflow each time, pass workflow_id. At least one of skill_id+endpoint_id, prompt, or workflow_id should be supplied; otherwise the routine just logs.

params.name: cron_expr
params.description: Schedule. Canonical: 'daily HH:MM', 'every Nm', 'every Nh', or 5-field cron. Natural language like 'every day at 5pm' is normalized automatically.

params.name: description
params.description: Human-readable description of what this routine does.

params.name: skill_id
params.description: Skill id to invoke on each run (e.g. 'calendar_google'). Pair with endpoint_id.

params.name: endpoint_id
params.description: Endpoint id of skill_id to invoke on each run (e.g. 'get_today').

params.name: args
params.description: Arguments object passed to the skill endpoint on each run.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Free-text instruction executed through the brain on each run (e.g. 'follow the line and report the result').

params.name: workflow_id
params.description: A workflow pack id to instantiate on each run.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Session id to associate the routine with.

params.name: recurring
params.description: If false, the routine fires once then disables itself. Defaults true.

params.name: tz_name
params.description: IANA timezone name for wall-clock schedules (e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles'). Defaults to the scheduler timezone.

endpoints.description: List existing routines, optionally filtered by session_id.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Filter to routines for this session. Omit for all routines.

endpoints.description: Delete a routine by its numeric id.

params.name: routine_id
params.description: Numeric id of the routine (from list/create).

endpoints.description: Pause (disable) a routine without deleting it.
Resume (re-enable) a previously paused routine and recompute its next run.
